rejected.detail: CORRECT PRODUCT: Valium Roche 5 mg diazepam, 50 tablets, two cartons, front face legible at 3264x1835. Rejected on market: 'AUST R 48566' is the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods, and the owner's rule is European packaging. The French Valium Roche accepted into 21_T1_Valium_Brand is the same brand done to EU rules.

outcome: insufficient_references — every European diazepam CARTON on Commons is the file already accepted into 21_T1_Valium_Brand; the rest are blisters, loose tablets, ampoules or bottles

owner_review.finding: Re-searched at the owner's request. The only European Valium carton photograph on Commons is Boites_de_Valium44.jpg, and its pixel hash is IDENTICAL to 21_T1_Valium_Brand/raw_valium_brand_01.jpg -- de02ad591b5cbd76. Duplicating one picture across two folders is forbidden, so 16 stays empty rather than sharing it. Everything else found was a blister strip (Pakistani Martin Dow under Roche licence), three loose tablets on a table, an ampoule, or a stock bottle.
